items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Gates LeadTagFilterMenu/LeadWaitToggleButton (via a new LeadTagFilterToolbarGroup wrapper) and LeadwrightFieldsFragment on useOrgChartPresence()==='absent', reusing the existing hook rather than a hand-typed 404 check; data-display chips (LeadOriginGlyph, TaskCardLeadExpander, TaskCardClaimChip) and the Inbox lead-question card are untouched; Org page/sidebar/navDestinations.ts and SHIPWRIGHT_LEADWRIGHT_CHECKOUT are untouched.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No new API routes or external calls; the presence hook's own loading/absent/broken handling is unchanged and already covers this.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, no new endpoints, no secrets touched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New tests assert on rendered-outcome (testid presence/absence), one case per presence state (absent/loading/broken/present) for both gated surfaces, plus a cross-presence-state test proving lead chips (LeadOriginGlyph, TaskCardLeadExpander) render regardless of presence.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: useOrgChartPresence rides the single shared ORG_CHART_QUERY_KEY cache entry (staleTime 60s, retryOnMount false) already used by SidebarNav/CommandCenter/OrgPage/LeadInventoryPage — no new fetch introduced.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: LeadTagFilter.tsx now 186 lines, LeadwrightFields.tsx 150 lines (both under 300). TaskBoardPage.tsx (446 lines) is pre-existing bloat-baseline debt, reduced by 10 lines by this change, not ratcheted (anti_ratchet_check.py exits 0).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format (JSON/YAML/config) changed — this is UI-only conditional rendering.
